title: Recipe tiles list each ingredient with a tiny icon and a short name, without amounts
description: The on-device model names each ingredient in one or two words, stored so it stays after a relaunch.

tasks.title: Do not show nutrition for individual items Also use the built in model to create short 1-2 word names for each ingredient that is stored in the db on save and used in these situations instead of truncating. Also show tiny icons for each item
